The Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission has released the CGPSC Result 2026 for the prelims exam on 25th March 2026, on its official website psc.cg.gov.in. The prelims exam was held on 22 February 2026. Based on the CGPSC prelims result, 3921 candidates have been selected for the next stage to fill 265 vacant posts in 20 different services. The selection process is done in stages like prelims, mains and interviews to recruit candidates for various administrative posts. The State Service Main Examination is scheduled to be held on 16, 17, 18, and 19 May 2026. All shortlisted candidates must apply online for the mains exam. Read the article below to know more about the CGPSC prelims result, exam dates, vacancies and selection process.

CGPSC Result 2026 Out

The CGPSC Result has now been declared at the official website of the Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission for the State Service (Preliminary) Examination conducted on 22 February 2026. Students who gave the exam can check their result in the PDF, which has the roll numbers and details of selected candidates. A total of 3921 candidates have been selected for the next stage of the process. Those who have passed should now start preparing for the mains exam and also complete the online application on time.

CGPSC Prelims Result 2026 Overview

The CGPSC Prelims Result 2026 has been released by the Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission for candidates who appeared in the State Service (Preliminary) Examination-2025. The result has been released online in PDF format, showing the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates. Those who cleared prelims will now appear for the mains examination stage.

CGPSC Result 2026
Organization Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC), Raipur
Exam Name State Service Examination 2025
Prelims Exam Date 22 February 2026
Result Status Declared

Result Mode Online (PDF)

Mains Exam Date 16, 17, 18, and 19 May 2026
Official Website www.psc.cg.gov.in

CGPSC Result 2026 Download PDF

The CGPSC Result 2026 has been released by the Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission in PDF format on its official website at www.psc.cg.gov.in. Candidates who appeared for the prelims exam can download the CGPSC PCS result to see if they have passed and are eligible for the next stage. The PDF has the list of candidates who cleared the prelims. The download link for the result PDF is given below. Candidates can now check their result online.

Download CGPSC Prelims Result 2026 PDF

How to Download CGPSC Prelims Result 2026?

To download the CGPSC Prelims Result 2026, candidates should go to the official website of the Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission. The result is given in a PDF file, where candidates can open it and search their roll number to see if they have passed or not. They can also download the PDF and save it for future use.

  1. Visit the official website psc.cg.gov.in
  2. Go to the “Results” section
  3. Click on the CGPSC Result 2026 link
  4. The result PDF will open on the screen
  5. Download the PDF and search your roll number
  6. Save or print the result for future reference

CGPSC Mains Exam Date

The CGPSC Mains Examination 2026 will be held by the Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission for candidates who qualified in the prelims stage. The mains exam is scheduled across multiple days and candidates need to complete the application process to appear for it.

Exam Stage Date
Mains Exam Day 1 16 May 2026
Mains Exam Day 2 17 May 2026
Mains Exam Day 3 18 May 2026
Mains Exam Day 4 19 May 2026

What Happens After CGPSC Prelims Results 2026 Result?

After the CGPSC Prelims Result 2026 is announced, those who pass move to the next stage i.e. Mains Exam. The Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission says that candidates who have been shortlisted must fill out the online application for the mains exam. The mains exam has descriptive questions from different subjects. Candidates who clear the mains will be called for the interview round. Final selection is based on performance in both the mains exam and the interview. Candidates should regularly check the official website for important updates.

CGPSC Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is the CGPSC result out for prelims written exam?

A: Yes, the Commission announced the CGPSC result on 25th march 2026.

Q2. Where can I check CGPSC Result 2026?

A: Candidates can check the result on the official website of CGPSC @psc.cg.gov.in.

Q3. In what format is the CGPSC written exam result released?

A: The result is out in PDF format and has roll numbers of shortlisted candidates.

Q4. How many candidates qualified in CGPSC Prelims 2026?

A: There are 3921 candidates who have qualified to take the main exam.

Q5. What is the next stage after prelims?

A: The next step is the State Service Main Examination, which is followed by the interview.

Q6. Do I have to apply again for the mains?

A: Yes, shortlisted candidates must apply online separately for the mains examination.
